drills.name: process_interruption
drills.expectation: pre-commit interruption leaves the run queued and retryable

drills.name: database_failure
drills.expectation: tampered SQLite backup is rejected without a partial restore root

drills.name: sse_resume
drills.expectation: Last-Event-ID resumes monotonically without model re-execution

drills.name: duplicate_request
drills.expectation: same request replays exactly and body drift conflicts

verification: pixi run -e dev pytest <the four selectors above> -q
